openQuestions: December 2026 quarter (due by mid-February): do coconut margins and exports stabilise, and do consumer brands return to profit?
What were the Rs 420m of new 'investment in equity instruments' (now Rs 1,202m) and the Rs 400m put into an existing subsidiary? Did the stake in Renuka Agri Foods rise above 53.03%?
Why was finance income Rs 294m in six months when only Rs 37m of interest was received in cash?
Renuka Enterprises now holds 56.57% of voting shares: any mandatory offer, delisting talk or further related-party deals?
Shaw Wallace lost Rs 398m in 2025/26 (note 18.3): consumer brands lost about Rs 93m in July–September — is Shaw Wallace the cause?

changeLog.summary: Requested from Telegram (/update ACL.N0000 COCO.N0000 DIST.N0000 HAYL.N0000 JINS.N0000 RHL.N0000). Read the September 2026 interim. Quarter revenue −24% to Rs 3.78bn, gross margin 16.9% (24.2%), owners' loss Rs 26m (profit Rs 493m); six-month owners' profit Rs 79m (Rs 576m); twelve-month EPS about Rs 0.19. Consumer brands slipped to a loss of about Rs 93m in the quarter. Operating cash flow Rs 465m for six months. Rs 420m more put into unexplained equity investments (now Rs 1,202m); Rs 152m moved from minority interests to owners. Renuka Enterprises now holds 56.57% of voting shares. NAV Rs 17.94. Opening March balance now matches the audited figures; no restatement of earlier periods. Cut normal EPS to 0.60/1.10/1.60, consumer brands to Rs 5/8/11 and owners' ROE to 5/8/11%. Fair value Rs 13.90 → 12.60, buy Rs 11.80 → 10.70, strong buy Rs 10.40 → 9.40. Business tests still 1 of 4 (debt only): category 3, avoid for now (unchanged). Renuka Agri Foods price kept at Rs 10.90 (11 Nov 2026), as no newer CSE close was available. Price Rs 22.50 voting, Rs 20.20 non-voting (CSE, 13 Nov 2026).
